judged_rule: judged is "published" where the v3.32 summary publishes a Code quality score: the equal mean of both judges. The two other rows, Low and Extra high codeccore, carry the reason their judge-derived fields are null
single_judge_rule: combined_single_judge recomputes the combined score with Code quality from one judge's reviewed score and intent recovery alone; it is a sensitivity figure, not the published score
intent_recovery_rule: When a submission passed no quirk family, intent recovery has no denominator and its 9 points move to the reviewed score for that submission (intent_recovery_redistributed); 0 Gemini 4 Neon runs needed it
unpublished_rule: Grok 4.6's intent probe of Low and Extra high codeccore returned malformed JSON on both attempts; the wrapper rule invalidate_unrecoverable_probe marked each call invalid, and the frozen summary publishes no Code quality score for a submission whose probe is invalid (owner choice, 2026-11-21, as v3.7 and v3.17 did). Both runs passed their tests and are timed and priced
hidden_behaviour_fields: hidden_behaviours counts the task's fail-to-pass hidden tests; hidden_behaviours_fixed counts those the run passed

cost_fields.estimated_usd: API-equivalent at the published list rates, stamped by the sweep at run time and recomputed from the Antigravity receipt with cached input at the cache-read rate

token_fields.raw_tokens: Antigravity raw total: input (cached included) plus output
token_fields.token_usage.output_tokens: includes thinking; Antigravity bills thinking as output
token_fields.token_usage.reasoning_output_tokens: the part of output Antigravity reports as thinking

tool_call_fields.tool_calls: tool calls in the run's archived tool-call log; every one is read_file, write_file, edit_file or run_command, the custom agent's allowlist
tool_call_fields.tool_call_errors: tool calls that returned an error

model_identity: harness-recorded: Antigravity reports the model it served (gemini-4-neon) on every run

rows.judged: unpublished: Grok 4.6's intent probe returned malformed JSON on both attempts (it quoted the codeccore memo line with its double quotes unescaped), invalidate_unrecoverable_probe marked the call invalid, and the frozen v3.32 summary publishes no Code quality score for a submission whose probe is invalid
